title: PR 129 example as a conformance vector
description: Engineering consequence of the DVC QR example as published on PR 129's branch (WHO 50bcb25, test participant XXA): its machine-readable summary and test DSC. The merged guide (af75be2) reissued the example under DEV participant XXR without publishing the DSC (STT-TST-011), so this pair remains the end-to-end verification vector.

statements.label: PR 129 example as a conformance vector
statements.requirement: Both libraries SHALL verify the two HC1 strings in dvc-qr-example-XXA.json against dvc-qr-example-XXA-dsc.pem, with the clock fixed inside 2026-09-29T08:30Z to 2027-09-29T08:30Z. Each SHALL give kid WHM+BYqqZiE=, subclaim -6, and payloads equal to those in the JSON. The committed files SHALL be used as-is; they SHALL NOT be regenerated.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-TST-001 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-TST-001 STT-KID-001 the vector's kid is the DSC's` (ConformanceVectorsTest.kt); `STT-TST-001 STT-PAY-001 both PR 129 certificates verify and decode as published` (ConformanceVectorsTest.kt)).
